numeric_json_abi.source: Historical W04N/json-reader-native.json and json-abi-native.json; parent-executed CatalogQuirks/RealtekEarly/W04N/NumericClosure/numeric-reader-native.json and numeric-wire-contract-observation.json qualify original V17/V19/JD readers and wire/cache boundaries independently.
numeric_json_abi.integer_storage: Signed32 saturation before callback. Numeric UDP ACK p preserves request entries; val and execution use the first parsed value per name. Worker internal ACK val and independently polled cached status use effective getters, not the upstream wire val.
numeric_json_abi.raw_number_policy: Parse the original JSON number token's leading signed decimal integer prefix before any Python float conversion: 1.5 and 1e3 read as 1, -1e-3 as -1. Preserve strict JSON syntax and reject nonnumber command values atomically as the explicit safe model policy.
numeric_json_abi.invalid_native_types: bool/null/string/array/object next-integer API returns -5 and preserves the output sentinel; this reader result is not a whole-command or atomic-batch claim.
numeric_json_abi.invocation_scope: The separate numeric-reader-native.json capture has 24 reader invocations per build, including repeated token 1 from its mixed vector. Its 69 distinct build/token pairs prove lexical reading only. The additional full-phase captures below independently qualify queued ACK/report-cache behavior; their mixed vector repeats reader token 2 while registered numeric parsing consumes p[0]=1.5.

full_registered_qualification.report_routes: Original poll task and selector cycles, worker MCU parser/comparison helper, native delta/builder/last-reported writer and source-selected mode-1 cache updater; separate event-9 DATA observes the worker cache.
full_registered_qualification.repeat_frame: Same mode-1 frame yields native delta return zero with Pow mask clear, handler 0x4e21/output length zero, no report builder/writer/updater and retained LAN cache.
full_registered_qualification.boundary: Declared virtual UART/RTOS/ROM/libc and available-SDK preconditions. Not physical timing, a full boot, external SDK event-3 producer/transport or whole-command atomicity proof.

mixed_numeric_projection.rule: Metadata independently reads p[0]; after metadata names are filtered, N numeric names consume the first N p entries, not their former opt indices.
mixed_numeric_projection.verification: All three original full native gates and three fresh actual CLI encrypted-UDP command/separate-status probes.

duplicate_name_contract.rule: First name occurrence is executed once; later duplicate values remain in p but do not replace the applied value.
